newsitem.title: INDIA: TENNIS-UNSEEDED PAVEL OUSTS FAVOURITE KRAJICEK.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-UNSEEDED PAVEL OUSTS FAVOURITE KRAJICEK.

text.p: Unseeded Romanian Andrei Pavel ousted Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek in two straight sets to earn a quarter-final place in the Indian Open tennis tournament on Thursday.
Top-seeded Krajicek of the Netherlands, the world's sixth ranked player, made too many unforced errors against the 132nd-ranked Pavel and crashed out of the second round 7-5 6-3.
Seventh seed Magnus Norman of Sweden rallied after losing the first set to overcome former Wimbledon champion Pat Cash of Australia 6-7 6-3 6-3.
The hot and humid weather left Cash, 32, looking tired after the first set but did not trouble his opponent who is 10 years younger.
American Jonathan Stark and Mikael Tillstrom of Sweden, the two other seeded players, were also extended to three sets before making the quarter-finals.

Fourth-seeded Stark looked in trouble against Marco Mengeschincheri of Italy before prevailing 4-6 7-5 6-0 while sixth seed Mikael Tillstrom dropped the second set before beating Frenchman Oliver Delaitre 6-1 3-6 6-0.
Eighth seed Lionel Roux of France was beaten by compatriot Gerard Solves 7-6 6-2.
